originalDsl:
@diagram uml-sequence
Customer actor as "Customer"
Checkout participant as "Checkout Service"
Gateway participant as "Payment Gateway"
Fraud participant as "Fraud Service"
Network participant as "Card Network"
Bank participant as "Bank"

msg_1 = Customer -#> Checkout as "submit payment details"
msg_2 = Checkout -#> Gateway as "authorize(amount, card token)"
msg_3 = Gateway -#> Fraud as "check transaction risk"
msg_4 = Fraud -.-> Gateway as "risk score: low"
msg_5 = Gateway -#> Network as "request authorization"
msg_6 = Network -#> Bank as "verify funds"
msg_7 = Bank -.-> Network as "funds available"
msg_8 = Network -.-> Gateway as "authorization code"
msg_9 = Gateway -.-> Checkout as "payment authorized"
msg_10 = Checkout -.-> Customer as "order confirmed"

injectedDefects.description: replaced closing quote on label "Checkout Service" with Unicode look-alike U+201D
